function.arguments: {"finding_id": 3, "resolution": "The confounding by customer segment is a critical issue. The raw difference in conversion rates is not valid because the email channel has a much higher proportion of loyal customers, who have higher conversion rates regardless of channel. This is the correct estimate of the campaign effect. The finding changes the method: we must use stratification, not raw comparison."}
